### Anthropic takes on Grok Bot, Meta's Muse, and OpenAI's Dots with its always-on agent "Claude Duet"
Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that handles tasks on its own, even when the user is offline. The app is built on Claude Opus 5.5 and connects to services like Gmail, Slack, and Stripe through more than 6,000 connectors. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/anthropic-takes-on-grok-bot-metas-muse-and-openais-dots-with-its-always-on-agent-claude-duet/), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/anthropic-unveils-claude-duet-challenge-openai-meta-ai-agent-field-3808873))

### OpenAI Makes Decisions API Generally Available with GPT-6 Luna
OpenAI made its Decisions API generally available on October 22, 2026, the company announced, taking the GPT-6 Luna–powered endpoint out of public beta at a price of $0.10 per million input tokens.
